ruleDefinitions.name: Dropping Of Password Filter DLL
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects dropping of dll files in system32 that may be used to retrieve user credentials from LSASS

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*HKLM\\\\SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\Lsa.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*scecli\\\\0*.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*reg\\ add.*"))
